justification: ⟦T1⟧ is a determinism/reproducibility check — resubmitting an identical prompt to measure output divergence — whereas ⟦T2⟧ plants distinctive few-shot phrasing to detect inappropriate verbatim carryover into outputs; the mechanisms and conditions share no specific common core beyond being evaluation practices.
